FX-PUSH-001.says: The settings as they start: completion 0, so nothing changes.

FX-PUSH-003.says: Completion 30: a hole in the middle, the picture pushed out round it, its middle stretched round the hole's edge.

FX-PUSH-004.says: Completion 60: a bigger hole, more of the picture pushed off.

FX-PUSH-005.says: Reversed, completion 30: the outside closed in, the picture pulled toward the middle.

FX-PUSH-006.says: Center [25, 30], completion 30: the hole moved up and to the left.

FX-PUSH-007.says: Completion 7.3: a small hole, every pixel read between pixels.

FX-PUSH-008.says: Center [120, 50], off the drawing to the right, completion 40: the hole's edge sweeps in from the right.

FX-PUSH-009.says: Completion keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 is completion 50, frame 4 all clear.

FX-PUSH-010.says: FX-PUSH-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-PUSH-012.says: Completion 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PUSH-013.says: Completion -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PUSH-014.says: Center x 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PUSH-015.says: Reverse "yes": it is "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PUSH-016.says: Reverse "On": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PUSH-017.says: Completion keyed to 150 at frame 4: a key outside the range. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
